title: ROOF BOWS, QUARTER PANEL TRIM & HEADLINING BRKTS
summary: Coupe (19437) body weld: the rear roof center bow (the cross bow at the rear of the T-top opening / top of the rear window), outer and inner LH/RH, and its joins to the side roof bows, plus the small brackets for quarter panel trim and headlining (headliner) welded to the bows. Everything is spotwelded at given pitches; locating holes are drilled through the inner bow using the outer bow's holes.
